Run **Independent check** and nothing else.

Follow [RV-check.md](../../playbook/RV-check.md), together with [query-protocol.md](../../playbook/query-protocol.md) and [labels-and-versions.md](../../playbook/labels-and-versions.md).

Read `brd-work/PROJECT.md`, `brd-work/STATUS.md` and the memory manifest first. Ask me whether to check the memory or which document (Functional, Technical or Summary) if it is not clear; for a document, also check it against the other approved documents. Write findings only; do not edit anything outside `brd-work/reviews/` (and your entries in `brd-work/query-log.md`).

Write the findings page, tell me where it is, and stop.
